notes.title: Announcing TV Beast
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 👋

I’m thrilled to introduce my upcoming survival horror game - TV Beast

A body-cam horror game where you confront the TV Beast using a special remote control. Collect materials, solve puzzles and upgrade the remote control to overcome the dangers created by the Beast.

🔗 Add it to your Steam Wishlist and share your friends
